ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

tooltip.anti-pattern-note: If you need custom buttons or interactive content, use Solaris Popover.
tooltip.arrow-note: Arrow is enabled by default and can be disabled.
tooltip.badge-count-note: Tooltip can explain badge counts or statuses.
tooltip.basic-hover-note: Hover or focus the trigger to see the tooltip. The default trigger is hover.
tooltip.click-closeable-note: When trigger is click and closeable is true, a close button is rendered.
tooltip.click-info: This tooltip persists on click. Try clicking outside or pressing Escape.
tooltip.click-trigger-note: Click the trigger to toggle the tooltip. Click outside or press Escape to close.
tooltip.closeable-info: This tooltip has a close button. Click it or press Escape to dismiss.

delays.note: Show and hide delays avoid flicker. Skip delay (Radix pattern) reopens immediately when the user moves between targets within 300ms.

tooltip.delays-demo: Hover me, leave, then hover again quickly.
tooltip.description: Tooltip is a short contextual information layer, used to explain something without taking up permanent space in the interface.
tooltip.disabled-explain: Editing is disabled for this item.
tooltip.disabled-note: When disabled, the tooltip does not open.
tooltip.disabled-text: This tooltip is disabled and will not appear.

examples.note: Start with the default hover tooltip, then explore triggers and variants below.

tooltip.icon-body-note: When there is no title, the icon aligns to the vertical center of the body text.
tooltip.icon-only-note: Tooltip provides accessible naming for icon-only buttons.
tooltip.icon-title-body-note: When a title is present, the icon aligns with the title.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the directive.

tooltip.max-width-long: This is a very long tooltip text that demonstrates how text breaks and wraps correctly within the max-width constraint.
tooltip.max-width-note: Default max-width is 320px. Long text wraps correctly.
tooltip.max-width-short: This tooltip has a max-width applied.
tooltip.metric-body: This metric considers the last 30 days.
tooltip.placements-note: Tooltip supports 12 placement options with reactive fallback.
tooltip.popover-warning: If you need buttons like "View details", "Configure", "Apply", or any interactive content, use Solaris Popover instead.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

tooltip.radius-note: Tooltip supports sm, md (default), and lg radius.

sizes-density.note: Size is the tooltip typographic density: font, padding, and arrow scale together. Overlays are exempt from the size × density height ladder.

tooltip.sizes-note: Tooltip supports sm (default), md, and lg sizes.
tooltip.template-content: Payment can take up to 48 hours to be confirmed.
tooltip.template-note: Templates are allowed but must not contain interactive content.
tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.title-body-note: Tooltip can have an optional title with heavier visual weight.

trigger.manual-note: Manual tooltips open only via open() or the controlled solarisTooltipOpen input.
